answer: Agents mint a non-transferable quartz identity token only after solving a unique walnut-tree growth puzzle whose solution requires continuous observation of a private island sensor feed. An attacker must physically maintain a separate sensor and run the puzzle solver for each fake identity; parallel clones share no progress because the island feed is unforgeable and time-locked. Each additional sybil therefore multiplies both hardware cost and real-time observation labor, making large farms economically prohibitive.
